original_ng_sentence: One dose made CAR-T cells inside the body and produced a deep, but apparently temporary, fall in B cells.

point_context:
## In one line…

One dose made CAR-T cells inside the body and produced a deep, but apparently temporary, fall in B cells. The report offers an important signal, but its lasting value will depend on what happens after B cells return.
